detail.longDescription:
AirClean Cleaner is a file management app designed to help you review storage usage and organize files on your device.

Main features:

• View device storage information
• Browse photos, videos, audio, and other files
• Find files with matching content
• Review large files
• View media associated with supported apps
• Check installed app information
• View basic device and battery details
• Select files before removing them
• Support for multiple languages

Files are removed only after user confirmation. Available features may vary depending on the device and Android version.
